name: Plex

install_consent_messages.en: Crow does not start a Plex server at install: it runs only if you start it from Extensions. If you do, the self-hosted Plex server uses host networking (Plex's own recommendation) so devices on your local network can discover it. It listens on every network interface of this machine (port 32400 and Plex's discovery ports) and mounts your media folder read-write. Until you claim it with your Plex account (PLEX_CLAIM_TOKEN), the first person who opens it can claim it.
install_consent_messages.es: Crow no inicia un servidor Plex al instalar: solo se ejecuta si lo inicias desde Extensiones. Si lo haces, el servidor Plex autoalojado usa la red del host (lo que recomienda Plex) para que los dispositivos de tu red local puedan descubrirlo. Escucha en todas las interfaces de red de esta máquina (el puerto 32400 y los puertos de descubrimiento de Plex) y monta tu carpeta de medios con lectura y escritura. Hasta que lo reclames con tu cuenta de Plex (PLEX_CLAIM_TOKEN), la primera persona que lo abra puede reclamarlo.

description: Connect to Plex Media Server — search library, browse collections, control playback, view active sessions
author: Crow

env_vars.name: PLEX_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Plex authentication token (see skill for how to find it)

env_vars.name: PLEX_MACHINE_ID
env_vars.description: Plex server machine identifier (optional, for multi-server setups)

env_vars.name: PLEX_MEDIA_PATH
env_vars.description: Host path for media files (Docker self-host mode)

env_vars.name: PLEX_CONFIG_PATH
env_vars.description: Host path for Plex config/database (Docker self-host mode)

env_vars.name: PLEX_CLAIM_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Plex claim token for initial server setup (Docker self-host mode, from plex.tv/claim)

env_vars.name: PLEX_ADVERTISE_URL
env_vars.description: URL other devices use to reach this Plex server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400. Leave blank to let Plex discover it. (Docker self-host mode)

pattern_hint.en: a URL starting with http:// or https://, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400
pattern_hint.es: una URL que empiece por http:// o https://, p. ej. http://192.168.1.10:32400

notes: Connects to an existing Plex Media Server. Optionally self-host via Docker (set PLEX_MEDIA_PATH + PLEX_CLAIM_TOKEN). Plex Web is a SPA and cannot be proxied behind a subpath.
